text.p: Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd said Thursday it refinanced the former Cluff Resources operations in Zimbabwe, acquired seven months ago.
The deal will allow the company to save more than $1 million a year in interest costs, Ashanti said in a statement.
The financing has been structured as a seven-year prepaid forward gold sale with the gold delivery underwritten by Ashanti Goldfields, the company said.
It said Ashanti Zimbabwe arranged the $40 million package with Union Bank of Switzerland and the Dresdner Bank AG Metals Group in New York.
The funds will be used to refinance $28 million of high-coupon debt and make available $12 million to finance expansion of the Freda Rebecca mine near Harare.
Ashanti said the deal was negotiated with the objective of stretching the maturity of the financing and maximizing the cash flow flexibility in the early years of the facility.

"We were looking for something better than a conventional gold loan which, even for borrowers of the highest standing, rarely extends beyond a five-year term. The advantages of this facility will enable the Zimbabwe subsidiary to prioritize its cash flow for investment in the mine," it said.
